en.content: If the probability that a randomly chosen 6-digit number formed by using digits 1 and 8 only is a multiple of 21 is p, then 96 p is equal to _______________.
en.explanation:
Total number of numbers from given

Condition = n(s) = 26.

Every required number is of the form

A = 7 . (10a1 + 10a2 + 10a3 + .......) + 111111

Here 111111 is always divisible by 21.

If A is divisible by 21 then

10a1 + 10a2 + 10a3 + ....... must be divisible by 3.

For this we have 6C0 + 6C3 + 6C6 cases are there

n(E) = 6C0 + 6C3 + 6C6 = 22

en.content: In the arrangement shown in figure a1, a2, a3 and a4 are the accelerations of masses m1, m2, m3 and m4 respectively. Which of the following relation is true for this arrangement?
en.explanation:
From virtual work done method,

4T a1 + 2T a2 + T a3 + T a4 = 0

4a1 + 2a2 + a3 + a4 = 0
